name: eager.moth
objective: Deliver milestone M0 — Scaffolding — per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §2, WPs M0-WP1..M0-WP7: canonical GPL-3.0 LICENSE, web build (vite+preact+ts strict, eslint complexity gates, vitest thresholds 80/60), Go shell (cmd/panelcraft serve/version, internal/server go:embed+SPA fallback+CSP+read-only /files/*), CI workflows + scripts/check-selfcontained.sh, scripts/verify.sh multi-stage runner, Playwright scaffold with S7 no-network smoke, docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md skeleton, docs/milestones/M0.md log.
completionCriterion: All M0 WPs done per PLAN §2 with DoD evidence in docs/milestones/M0.md, and the CI-equivalent local gate passes: `bash scripts/verify.sh m0` exits 0 (npm check+build+test, go vet/staticcheck/gocyclo/test, e2e smoke with network blocked, asset-origin scan).
handover: CONTEXT: all specs live on disk — chat history is never needed. ENTRY READS ONLY: (1) agents.md (ground rules, commands, DoD); (2) docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §2 (WP table = your task list); (3) grep docs/SPEC.md for cited ids (§8.5–8.6, §9 M0, §14) — never full-read. PROTOCOL: (a) persist decisions+evidence continuously to docs/milestones/M0.md — disk is memory, chat is ephemeral; (b) one WP per PR-sized diff, cite WP ids; (c) run gates per WP (npm run check/test, go vet+staticcheck+gocyclo, e2e smoke), not once at end; (d) FIRST task creates scripts/verify.sh with stage `m0` — later milestones extend it. EXIT CONTRACT: verify.sh m0 exit 0; M0.md DoD checklist filled with pasted command outputs; LICENSE = canonical GPLv3 text; repo tree matches agents.md map. Next goal (M1) starts cold via freshContext: it reads only its handover + PLAN §3 + tail of M0.md — leave nothing required in chat.
